incumbent_baseline.IMPORTANT_digest_caveat: This lineage is NOT the sha256:b06ffd67... recorded in tests/fixtures/has_cubical_layer.lineage.json. That value was measured on 2026-08-11 at clean bba1239ea, where the crate disambiguator was clean_kernel[c15e]; here it is clean_kernel[1f2d]. The A-LIN v2 framing prefixes the body's DefPathHash, so ANY change to the crate moves every body's digest. The 2026-08-11 fixture is a correct record of that build and is deliberately not rewritten; the value here is the correct record of THIS build. A digest is a per-build artifact identity, not a stable name for a function.
